translation.title: Analgesic and Anti-inflammatory Cataplasm (Pap)
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for the analgesic and anti-inflammatory relief of low back pain, shoulder pain, joint pain, muscle pain, osteomyelitis (pain of the hand and wrist), elbow pain (such as tennis elbow), bruises, and sprains.
translation.usage: Apply 1 patch to the affected area once or twice a day.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine in the following cases: people who are hypersensitive to this medicine; people who have experienced asthma attacks caused by non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs; children under 11 years of age. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before using this medicine in the following cases: women who are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding; people with bronchial asthma; people with an allergic constitution; people with severe moist skin or erosion; people who are hypersensitive to cosmetics. Follow the prescribed dosage and directions. When it is used by a child, use it under the supervision of a guardian. This medicine is for external use only. Take care to keep it out of the eyes and mucous membranes; if it gets into the eyes, rinse them immediately with water or warm water. Do not use this medicine in the following cases: eczema; dermatitis caused by lacquer or the like; wounded areas; athlete’s foot; ringworm; suppurating (pus-filled) areas. If you have been sweating or the affected area is wet, wipe the area dry before use. Do not warm the area where the patch is applied with an electric heater, an electric blanket or the like. Remove it 1 hour before bathing and apply it about 30 minutes after bathing. Do not touch the area around the eyes, the lips, the ears or any wounded area with hands that have touched this medicine. Stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist if any of the following occur: rash and redness (congestion and reddening); itching; lacquer dermatitis; a burning sensation; swelling; pain; a feeling of heat; dryness. Store at room temperature, protected from moisture and light. Keep out of reach of children.
